calendar: Per Ian: academic calendar. A 2012–2015 range expands to 2012–2013, 2013–2014 and 2014–2015. It supplies annual interval evidence, not exact appointment days or independent proof of semester-level activity. Summer posts remain unmatched.
limits: Directory intervals and signed semester lists are distinct evidence. Role counts overlap across programs; duplicates are deduplicated by reviewed name/role/year with all claims retained. Missing matches are not proof of nonmembership or incorrect authorship.
